author: COREMERCH
excerpt: Payment confirmed on-chain, webhook received, order logged, delivery email sent — all within 30 seconds. The fully automated sovereign commerce pipeline.

imageCaption: NOWPayments webhook fires, Cloudflare Worker receives, order logs, delivery email sends — all within 30 seconds.

content.text: The difference between a sovereign store and a manual operation is not scale — it is [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/real-architecture-behind-automated-ebook-delivery-after-crypto-8|architecture]]. A manual operation requires your attention for every order. A sovereign store processes orders identically whether you are watching or not, whether it is midnight or noon, whether it receives one order or fifty simultaneously. NOW[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/payment-solutions-zimbabwean-digital-sellers-every-detail-you-2|COREMERCH guide to payment]]s monitors the blockchain continuously. The webhook fires the moment a transaction receives on-chain confirmations. Your [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/cloudflare-workers-crypto-payment-webhooks-explained-digital-creators-14|Cloudflare Workers]] Worker receives the webhook, validates the signature, confirms the transaction independently on the blockchain, logs the order to your Supabase database, generates a presigned download URL from Cloudflare R2 with a configurable expiry time, and sends the delivery email via Resend. The buyer receives their product before they have navigated away from the payment confirmation page.
What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Google apps

Google Apps Script is a powerful tool for automating digital commerce, allowing creators to focus on their products rather than the underlying infrastructure. By leveraging Google Apps Script, creators can build a sovereign stack that processes orders quickly and efficiently, without relying on third-party platforms. This approach enables creators to maintain control over their data and customer relationships, ensuring a more sustainable and scalable business model.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture of Google Apps Script for digital commerce automation relies on a combination of Cloudflare Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments. Cloudflare Workers handles webhook events, triggering order fulfillment and automated digital product delivery. Supabase provides a scalable database for storing orders, while NOWPayments enables crypto payments with a 0.5% fee. This integrated approach ensures seamless order processing and delivery, all within a sovereign stack.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This solution is built for digital creators in regions where conventional platforms are restricted or unavailable. By providing an alternative to Stripe and PayPal, Google Apps Script for digital commerce automation empowers creators to reach a global audience and monetize their digital products. This approach is particularly suitable for creators selling ebooks, courses, templates, and other digital products, who require a reliable and efficient order processing system.
Automate digital product delivery with crypto payments using Google Apps Script and NOWPayments.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The components of Google Apps Script for digital commerce automation work together to provide a seamless order processing experience. Cloudflare Workers handles 100,000 webhook events per day on the free tier, ensuring that orders are processed quickly and efficiently. Supabase provides a scalable database for storing orders, while NOWPayments enables crypto payments with a low fee. Google Apps Script integrates these components, automating order fulfillment and digital product delivery.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy Google Apps Script for digital commerce automation today, creators can start by setting up a Cloudflare Workers account and integrating it with Supabase and NOWPayments. Next, they can configure Google Apps Script to automate order fulfillment and digital product delivery. With the Edge Commerce Stack ($197), creators can get started with a pre-configured stack, including Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments, and receive 30-day support to ensure a smooth deployment.
How does automated digital product delivery work with crypto payments?

Automated digital product delivery with crypto payments works by using a webhook to trigger order fulfillment. When a customer makes a payment, the webhook is fired, and the order is processed automatically. This approach ensures that digital products are delivered quickly and efficiently, without requiring manual intervention. With NOWPayments, creators can accept over 300 cryptocurrencies, with a low fee of 0.5%, and without requiring KYC or buyer accounts.
